subject: Security review kickoff & stakeholder mapping - Medora Health
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@medora.health>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@medora.health>
Date: 2026-07-10T15:02:00Z
Subject: Follow-up + stakeholder mapping from today's discovery call

Thanks again for your time today — really appreciated the open conversation about your use cases for model-powered summarization across clinical notes. Quick recap and requested next steps: 

- Outcome: Medora is evaluating Redwood for low-latency inference in the chart summarization pipeline (primary) and a future exploration for patient-facing Q&A (secondary).
- Decision criteria you mentioned: latency (<200ms p50), HIPAA readiness, support for private deployments (VPC), and predictable costing.
- Stakeholders I heard: Raj (economic buyer/ops), Michael (security/CISO), procurement for contracting.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Introduce our security lead to kick off the questionnaire and scope (cc'ing Marissa).
2) Share our Redwood security questionnaire + a short mutual action plan (attached).
3) Schedule a 30-45m security kickoff next week to align on systems in-scope and evidence delivery timeline.

I've attached a short mutual-action-plan and our standard security questionnaire to get started. Can you confirm the economic buyer and the security contact, plus which environments will be in-scope (production, staging, analytics, admin)?

Thanks,
Neha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0186

Attachments: Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx (stub), Redwood-Security-Questionnaire.pdf (stub)

Thanks Neha — great recap. Confirming stakeholders: 
- Raj Patel — VP, Clinical Ops (economic buyer)
- Michael Torres — Head of Security / acting CISO (security contact)
- Procurement (procurement@medora.health) — handles PO & contract terms

Environments in-scope for initial security review: 
- Production (primary cluster running patient-facing summarization)
- Staging (pre-prod mirroring production configs)
- Admin console (internal access for model config / keys)

We are not including analytics pipelines (data warehouse) in scope for the first pass.

Happy to take the questionnaire — I've shared it with Michael and procurement. Can we target a kickoff the week of Jul 20?

Best,
Samantha
Director, Product Ops | Medora Health

Looping in a quick intake and suggested evidence checklist for the kickoff: 

Suggested initial evidence (to collect pre-kickoff where possible):
- Network diagram showing VPCs/subnets and peering (redacted)
- List of IAM roles & SAML providers for admin console access
- Logging/monitoring retention policy and where logs are stored (CloudWatch / Stackdriver / SIEM)
- Data flow diagram for PII PHI elements (redacted)
- Any existing penetration test / vulnerability scan reports (last 12 months)

Proposed kickoff agenda (30-45m):
1) Introductions & scope confirmation (5m)
2) Systems in-scope walk-through (10m)
3) Evidence collection plan & timelines (10m)
4) Access requirements / next steps for evidence delivery (10m)
5) Q&A & scheduling follow-ups (5-10m)

Timeline: we can run the kickoff the week of Jul 20 — I have availability on Tue Jul 21 10:00-11:30 PT or Wed Jul 22 13:00-15:00 PT. If procurement needs to discuss contract timeline, happy to include Neha on that thread as well.

Marissa Cole
Senior Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
